verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents exporting scan results to SARIF, an open format, and a hands-on report confirms real use of that SARIF output. It also offers an API to gather findings and can generate SBOMs. However, nothing shows a complete, all-data export path for leaving the platform. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of all platform data (triage history, comments, settings, projects), a documented offboarding or account-export workflow, and evidence that platform data is portable beyond per-scan results.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: To export the results to a SARIF file: semgrep ci --sarif --sarif-output=semgrep.sarif
